caption: The drawing features twelve rectangular and square textile swatches arranged in three rows on a neutral beige background. The top row contains five smaller swatches: from left to right, the first is a multicolored plaid pattern with greens and browns, the second is a pink and white linear botanical pattern, the third is a green and yellow floral design on a dark background, the fourth is a small black and white floral repeat on grey, and the fifth is maroon with a white floral motif. The second row contains four mid-sized swatches: the first and third are brown with large turquoise and white floral patterns, the second is a tan fabric with small pink flowers and leafy stems, and the fourth is divided horizontally—the upper section white with scattered pink and purple flowers, the lower section tan with a similar but denser botanical motif. The bottom row consists of three larger swatches: the left is sky blue with a red, black, and white floral and leaf design; the center is cream with a cluster of red and purple flowers and foliage; the right is off-white with an intricate black vine and red and purple leaves motif. The background shows visible aging, and there are handwritten numbers and text beneath some swatches.
title: Textiles in Patchwork Quilt
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
